title: ¿Cómo sigue?
desc: Nobody in the house will say the word out loud
setting: Don Beto has not got out of bed in a week and his house is full of people you have never met.

steps.speaker: Doña Rosa
steps.en: Come in, love. He is delicate.

options.en: And how is he getting on, doña?
options.feedback: Cómo sigue, not cómo está. One asks after a person over time and the other asks for a fact, and everybody who walks through that door asks the first.
Understood, and it sounds like a form being filled in. Cómo sigue is what the room is saying.
Nobody says grave out loud. She said delicado, which is how it is said, and saying the other word feels like calling it down on him.

steps.speaker: Doña Rosa
steps.es: Ahí va. Anoche durmió un poco.
steps.en: He is getting there. Last night he slept a little.

options.es: Qué bueno, doña. Primero Dios se compone.
options.en: That is good, doña. God willing he will pick up.
options.feedback: Take the small good news and add the formula. In a house like this nobody is asking you for a prognosis, only for hope said correctly.
Kind and correct. Componerse is the verb people use for coming back from an illness like this one.

options.en: And what exactly did the doctor say?
options.feedback: She has been avoiding that sentence all week on purpose. Asking for the detail asks her to say the thing nobody is saying.

steps.speaker: Doña Rosa
steps.es: Siéntese un rato. Está lleno de gente pero él la oye.
steps.en: Sit down for a while. It is full of people but he can hear it.

options.es: Aquí me quedo un rato, doña.
options.en: I will stay a while, doña.
options.feedback: That is the whole visit. Nobody comes to say anything clever, they come to be in the house and to be counted.

options.en: I only came to say hello.
options.feedback: Nobody only comes to say hello here. Staying half an hour costs you nothing and is noticed.

options.es: No quiero molestar con tanta gente.
options.en: I do not want to be in the way with so many people.
options.feedback: The point is the number of people. An empty house at a time like this is the thing everybody is working to prevent.

steps.speaker: Doña Rosa
steps.en: And do you want to go in and see him?

options.es: Si él puede, sí. Solo un momento.
options.en: If he is able, yes. Only for a moment.
options.feedback: Yes, and short. You leave the decision with her and you do not sit at the bed for an hour.
Respectful. She asked because she wanted an answer, not the decision back.

options.en: Better not, so as not to tire him out.
options.feedback: She offered because he would want to see you. Refusing spares him nothing and it is the one thing he will hear about.
